title: DeepWater
description: Changes the standard fishing system and allows you to customize your loot
body:
🎣 Deepwater

Reimagining fishing in Minecraft: dynamic hotspots, smart fish scaring, and custom loot!

--- **Deepwater** is an advanced fishing plugin that makes fishing in Minecraft truly engaging, tactical, and alive. Forget about boring AFK fishing at a single water block. Now fishing requires attention, searching for hotspots, and silence! ## ✨ Key Features ### 🌊 Dynamic Hotspots Fish no longer bite equally everywhere! Special "hotspots" appear in bodies of water. - Hotspots provide a **bonus to the chance** of catching rare loot and fishing speed. - Each hotspot has a **fish limit**: once anglers catch all the fish in the area, the hotspot is depleted, and you'll have to find a new spot. ### 🤫 Smart Scaring System (Fishing Scares) Fish have become smarter and more easily scared. You can scare away your catch if you're not careful! What scares the fish: - Sudden movements, sprinting, or jumping near the bobber. - Placing or breaking blocks on the shore. - Explosions (TNT), falling items (splashes), or entities taking damage nearby. - Talking in chat or even in **voice chat** (Simple Voice Chat integration)! ### 💎 Fully Custom Loot (GUI Editor) Configure your catch right in the game! No messing around with configs: - **Convenient `/dw loot` menu**: Add any item from your inventory directly to the loot table. - Configure **drop chances** with extreme precision (down to `0.001%`). - Set **limits**: how many times a single player can get an item, or how many times it can drop globally on the entire server (perfect for unique event items!). - **Biome bindings**: make it so a legendary sword can only be caught in the ocean. - Blast Fishing support (TNT fishing). ### 📊 Statistics & Leaderboards The plugin automatically tracks detailed catch statistics for every player! - **Detailed Stats Breakdown**: The `/dw info ` command and `/dw stats` menu show not just the total number of catches, but also the exact amount of each specific fish or item caught! - **`/dw stats` menu**: Opens a beautiful GUI with player heads, displaying their statistics. You can sort the leaderboard by Best, Worst, or Alphabetically. - **PlaceholderAPI Support**: Display leaderboards on holograms or scoreboards! (e.g., `%deepwater_top_name_total_1%` to display the server's best angler). ### ⚙️ Convenient Admin Panel Forget about reloading the server just to change one line in the config! - The `/dw` command opens the control panel. - Toggle fishing mini-games, vanilla loot, TNT fishing, and the scaring system on the fly. - Instant plugin language switching (English / Russian) right in the menu! --- ## 🔌 Integrations - **Simple Voice Chat** *(optional)*: If Simple Voice Chat is installed on the server, players can accidentally scare the fish by talking loudly in voice chat! - **Mini-games**: An optional built-in fishing mini-game when reeling in a fish for those who like a challenge. ## 🛠️ Commands & Permissions | Command | Description | Permission | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | `/dw` | Open the main settings panel | `deepwater.settings` | | `/dw stats` | Open the leaderboards (GUI) | `deepwater.stats` | | `/dw info ` | View player statistics | `deepwater.info` | | `/dw info hotspots` | Info about the nearest hotspot | `deepwater.info` | | `/dw loot` | Open the loot editor | `deepwater.loot` | | `/dw hotspots` | List of active hotspots | `deepwater.hotspots` | | `/dw near` | Find the nearest hotspot | `deepwater.near` | | `/dw gen` | Generate a hotspot at your current location | `deepwater.gen` | | `/dw reset` | Reset loot limits | `deepwater.reset` | > 💡 **Note**: Administrators with the `deepwater.admin` permission automatically get access to all these subcommands. --- ## 🌍 Localization (Languages) Deepwater supports **English** and **Russian** languages out of the box. You can change the language with one click in the `/dw` menu (compass icon). The entire interface instantly adapts to the selected language!
